newsitem.title: POLAND: NFI UNITS SOAR ON SBC WARBURG'S "BUY".
newsitem.headline: NFI UNITS SOAR ON SBC WARBURG'S "BUY".

text.p: Polish mass privatisation units soared 9.7 percent to 164 zlotys ($54.7) in a heavy 46.9-million-zloty turnover because of a buy recommendation from SBC Warburg in London, traders said.
"The recommendation helped the units to get out of their long stabilisation-phase," one trader said.

Analysts said the news that the Bank of New York created a US-dollar denominated Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) for the units, indicating that it had bought a large amount of the units, was also a positive signal.
SBC Warburg advised investors to buy the units at up to $80 through the newly created GDR.
But some Polish analysts saw a possible further rise of the units capped at around 200 zlotys ($66.7).
